properties.title: LP NS Sn-Covered Sensor (Thermal + Epithermal) – Pixon Reconstruction (Wilson et al., 2018)
properties.lri:data_use_note: Spatial targeting, not quantitative estimate. Values are blended neutron count rates (thermal + epithermal) — use this map for bulk composition context and cross-referencing, not as a standalone hydrogen proxy. For hydrogen prospecting, prefer epithermal_wilson.json.
properties.psf_function: kappa function (Lawrence et al., 2003; Maurice et al., 2004)
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.authors: J. T. Wilson, D. J. Lawrence, P. N. Peplowski, J. T. S. Cahill, V. R. Eke, R. J. Massey, L. F. A. Teodoro
properties.lri:quality_note: MEP reconstruction of the LP-NS Sn-covered sensor (Wilson et al., 2018, Dataset S3). Effective resolution 38 km vs. ~45 km FWHM original PSF. The Sn detector records blended thermal + epithermal neutrons — NOT a standalone hydrogen proxy, as thermal neutrons are sensitive to multiple absorbers (Fe, Ti, Gd, Sm, Cl). Note: the PDS 'thermal' product (therms.dat) is the Sn–Cd difference; this is the raw Sn signal before that subtraction. Use for bulk composition context alongside the epithermal product.
properties.processing:lineage: Upstream NS data reduction: Maurice et al. (2004). PSF determined from kappa function (Lawrence et al., 2003; Maurice et al., 2004) accounting for spacecraft motion (Wilson et al., 2015). Pixon reconstruction applied by Wilson et al. (2018). COG production: source jgre20969-sup-0004-supplementary.txt (Dataset S3); comment lines stripped; 524288 space-delimited values parsed as column-major layout (1024 longitude-bins × 512 latitude-bins, longitude -180→+180, latitude south→north); transposed to row-major (512 lat-rows × 1024 lon-cols) then V-flipped to north→south for GDAL north-up convention; written as AAIGrid (ncols=1024, nrows=512, cellsize=0.3515625°); gdal_translate to COG with IAU:30100, DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
